A '''thermostatic cleaner''' was a type of cleaning device. When the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] and her [[Gender/Legends|son]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] hosted the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] for a meal at their [[Skywalker home/Legends|home]] in [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]]<ref name="Inside" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Shmi had a thermostatic cleaner stored behind a panel on a shelf in her kitchen.<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
A thermostatic cleaner was first mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
